description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages achieved by five different reinforcement learning methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct multimodal reasoning benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three benchmarks in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with tick marks spaced at 0.5-point intervals. Each benchmark has five vertical bars, each corresponding to one of the five methods, distinguished by unique color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection is solid blue, DAPO is light blue with diagonal stripes, GRPO is orange with diagonal stripes, PPO+Self-reflection is solid green, and PPO is green with diagonal stripes. For the Mathverse benchmark, the accuracies are approximately 53% for DAPO, 54% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.5% for GRPO, 53.5% for PPO, and 54% for PPO+Self-reflection. For MMLU, the accuracies are approximately 56% for DAPO, 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for GRPO, 54.5% for PPO, and 56.5% for PPO+Self-reflection. For Physics, the accuracies are approximately 57.5% for DAPO, 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58% for GRPO, 59% for PPO, and 59% for PPO+Self-reflection. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the same order for each benchmark, with no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar.
